objective.title: Preserve Levi-Civita compatibility through the explicit-model derivative API
objective.statement: Permit only six extDerivFun f -> mvfderiv I f substitutions with the same original modelI and scalar codomain. Old/current operator formulas proved equal by rfl, and all normalized originaltypes passed rigid checks. Preserve whole-source remainder and all proof bodies, TorsionFreeAt, metric/connection/norms/hypotheses. This enables retained-root final verified endpoint integration; existing connection uniqueness/Koszul consumers use original assertions. S remains discharged; no independent H existence is constructed.
deliverables: The exact original compatibility/uniqueness/Koszul interfaces compile after semantic-preserving API normalization, or exact remaining proof failures are preserved before any successor scope.
